id: title:Gilbert09:stream redshift rows instead of declaring a cursor

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion connector, specifically the chunked-streaming mode implementation.
review.reason: The implementation chunk P1.F1.H3 introduces a chunked-streaming mode for Redshift ingestion, preferring it over the server-side cursor fallback. This change could help prevent Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors and reduce latency for large tables by avoiding the materialization of the entire result set on the worker, provided libpq >= 17.
